doc_title: Aegis Insurance - Claims Processing and SLA Policy
text: Aegis Insurance - Claims Processing and SLA Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Turnaround Times Acknowledgement of a claim is issued within 24 hours of intimation. A surveyor, where required, is appointed within 48 hours. Once all documents are received, the claim decision is communicated within 15 working days and payment within 7 days thereafter. Required Documents Standard documents include the duly filled claim form, policy copy, KYC of the claimant, and proof of loss. Health claims need discharge summary and bills; motor claims need the FIR (if applicable), driving licence, and repair estimate. Repudiation If a claim is rejected, the reason and the specific policy clause are communicated in writing.

doc_title: Aegis Insurance - Claims Processing and SLA Policy
text: Health claims need discharge summary and bills; motor claims need the FIR (if applicable), driving licence, and repair estimate. Repudiation If a claim is rejected, the reason and the specific policy clause are communicated in writing. The claimant may appeal to the Grievance Redressal Officer within 30 days. Fraudulent claims lead to rejection and may render the policy void. Escalation If a claim is not settled within the stated SLA, the claimant may escalate to the Claims Head, and subsequently to the Insurance Ombudsman if unresolved within 30 days.

doc_title: Aegis Bank - Credit Card Cardholder Agreement
text: Aegis Bank - Credit Card Cardholder Agreement Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Billing and Interest The billing cycle is monthly. An interest-free credit period of up to 50 days applies if the total amount due is paid by the due date. Finance charges of 3.5% per month (42% per annum) apply on unpaid balances and on cash advances from the date of transaction. Fees The annual fee is Rs. 999, waived on annual spends of Rs. 2,00,000 or more. Cash advance fee is 2.5% of the amount withdrawn, minimum Rs. 500. Late payment fee ranges from Rs. 400 to Rs. 1,300 based on the outstanding balance.

doc_title: Aegis Bank - Credit Card Cardholder Agreement
text: Cash advance fee is 2.5% of the amount withdrawn, minimum Rs. 500. Late payment fee ranges from Rs. 400 to Rs. 1,300 based on the outstanding balance. Minimum Amount Due The Minimum Amount Due is 5% of the total outstanding or Rs. 200, whichever is higher, plus any overlimit and unpaid amounts. Paying only the minimum extends repayment and attracts finance charges. Liability for Fraud Report a lost or stolen card immediately. For unauthorized transactions reported within 3 days, cardholder liability is zero. Reporting after 3 days may result in limited liability as per regulatory guidelines. Always protect your PIN and OTP.

doc_title: Aegis Bank - Fixed Deposit Terms and Conditions
text: Aegis Bank - Fixed Deposit Terms and Conditions Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Tenure and Rates Fixed deposits are accepted for tenures from 7 days to 10 years. Interest rates range from 4.0% to 7.1% per annum depending on tenure. Senior citizens earn an additional 0.50% per annum over the applicable rate. Premature Withdrawal Premature withdrawal is allowed with a penalty of 1.0% on the applicable rate for the period the deposit remained with the bank. Deposits of 5-year tax-saver type have a mandatory lock-in of 5 years and cannot be withdrawn prematurely. Interest Payout and TDS Interest may be paid monthly, quarterly, or on maturity (cumulative).

doc_title: Aegis Bank - Fixed Deposit Terms and Conditions

doc_title: Aegis Financial - Grievance Redressal Policy
text: Aegis Financial - Grievance Redressal Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Level 1 - Customer Care Raise a complaint via the branch, call centre, or email. A ticket is issued and a first response is provided within 48 hours. Most complaints are resolved within 7 working days. Level 2 - Grievance Officer If unsatisfied with the Level 1 resolution, escalate to the Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO). The GRO responds within 10 working days. The GRO's name and contact are displayed at every branch and on the website. Level 3 - Ombudsman If the complaint is not resolved within 30 days, or the response is unsatisfactory, the customer may approach the Banking or Insurance Ombudsman, free of charge.

doc_title: Aegis Health Shield - Health Insurance Policy
text: Aegis Health Shield - Health Insurance Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Scope of Cover This policy covers hospitalization expenses for illness or injury requiring a minimum of 24 consecutive hours of in-patient care. Day-care procedures listed in Annexure A are covered even if hospitalization is under 24 hours. The sum insured options are Rs. 3,00,000, Rs. 5,00,000, and Rs. 10,00,000 per policy year. Waiting Periods An initial waiting period of 30 days applies from the policy commencement date, except for accidental injuries. Pre-existing diseases are covered after a continuous waiting period of 36 months. Specified illnesses such as cataract, hernia, and joint replacement have a waiting period of 24 months.

doc_title: Aegis Health Shield - Health Insurance Policy
text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after a continuous waiting period of 36 months. Specified illnesses such as cataract, hernia, and joint replacement have a waiting period of 24 months. Room Rent and Sub-limits Room rent is capped at 1% of the sum insured per day for normal rooms and 2% for ICU. For cataract surgery, the limit is Rs. 40,000 per eye. Maternity benefit is available after a 9-month waiting period, up to Rs. 50,000 for normal delivery. Exclusions The policy does not cover cosmetic surgery, dental treatment unless arising from accident, self-inflicted injury, treatment for alcohol or drug abuse, and expenses for spectacles, contact lenses, or hearing aids. Claim Process For cashless treatment, intimate the network hospital and Aegis at least 48 hours before planned admission, or within 24 hours of emergency admission.

doc_title: Aegis Health Shield - Health Insurance Policy

doc_title: Aegis Bank - Home Loan Policy
text: Aegis Bank - Home Loan Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Eligibility Salaried applicants aged 21 to 60 and self-employed applicants aged 25 to 65 are eligible. Minimum net monthly income required is Rs. 30,000. Co-applicants are permitted and their income may be clubbed to enhance loan eligibility. Loan Amount and LTV The maximum Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio is 90% for loans up to Rs. 30 lakh, 80% for loans between Rs. 30 lakh and Rs. 75 lakh, and 75% for loans above Rs. 75 lakh. Maximum tenure is 30 years or up to retirement age, whichever is earlier. Interest Rate Home loans are offered on a floating rate linked to the Repo Rate plus a spread of 2.25% to 3.00% based on the applicant's credit score.

doc_title: Aegis Bank - Home Loan Policy
text: Interest Rate Home loans are offered on a floating rate linked to the Repo Rate plus a spread of 2.25% to 3.00% based on the applicant's credit score. A processing fee of 0.50% of the loan amount, subject to a minimum of Rs. 10,000, is applicable. Prepayment and Foreclosure No prepayment or foreclosure charges apply to floating-rate home loans taken by individual borrowers. For fixed-rate loans, a foreclosure charge of 2% of the outstanding principal applies. Documentation Required documents include KYC proof, last 3 months' salary slips or 2 years' ITR, 6 months' bank statements, and property title documents. Disbursement is made after legal and technical verification of the property.

doc_title: Aegis Financial - KYC and Anti-Money-Laundering Policy
text: Aegis Financial - KYC and Anti-Money-Laundering Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Purpose This policy establishes the framework for Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) obligations to prevent the firm from being used for money laundering or terrorist financing, in line with applicable regulations. Customer Identification Every customer must be identified using an Officially Valid Document (OVD): Aadhaar, passport, voter ID, driving licence, or NREGA job card, along with a PAN. Identification is mandatory at onboarding and on any suspicious activity. Risk Categorisation Customers are classified as low, medium, or high risk. High-risk customers, including politically exposed persons (PEPs), undergo Enhanced Due Diligence and their KYC is reviewed every 2 years; low-risk every 10 years; medium-risk every 8 years.

doc_title: Aegis Financial - KYC and Anti-Money-Laundering Policy
text: High-risk customers, including politically exposed persons (PEPs), undergo Enhanced Due Diligence and their KYC is reviewed every 2 years; low-risk every 10 years; medium-risk every 8 years. Reporting Cash transactions of Rs. 10,00,000 or above are reported as Cash Transaction Reports (CTRs). Transactions that appear suspicious are reported as Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) regardless of amount, within 7 working days of detection.

doc_title: Aegis SecureLife - Term Life Insurance Policy
text: Aegis SecureLife - Term Life Insurance Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Benefit On death of the life assured during the policy term, the nominee receives the Sum Assured. Sum assured options range from Rs. 25,00,000 to Rs. 2,00,00,000. Policy terms of 10, 20, and 30 years are available; entry age is 18 to 65 years. Premium and Grace Period Premiums may be paid annually, half-yearly, or monthly. A grace period of 30 days (15 days for monthly mode) is allowed for premium payment. If premium is unpaid after the grace period, the policy lapses. Suicide Clause If the life assured dies by suicide within 12 months from the date of commencement or revival of the policy, the nominee receives 80% of the total premiums paid, and the contract terminates.

doc_title: Aegis SecureLife - Term Life Insurance Policy
text: Suicide Clause If the life assured dies by suicide within 12 months from the date of commencement or revival of the policy, the nominee receives 80% of the total premiums paid, and the contract terminates. Riders Optional riders include Accidental Death Benefit, Critical Illness cover for 36 listed conditions, and Waiver of Premium on permanent disability. Riders must be opted at inception or on a policy anniversary. Free Look and Revival The policyholder may cancel within a 15-day free-look period for a refund of premium less proportionate risk charges. A lapsed policy can be revived within 5 years by paying due premiums with interest.

doc_title: Aegis Motor Secure - Private Car Insurance Policy
text: Aegis Motor Secure - Private Car Insurance Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Coverage This policy provides Own Damage (OD) cover for loss or damage to the insured vehicle, and mandatory Third-Party (TP) liability cover. The Insured Declared Value (IDV) is the maximum amount payable in case of total loss or theft. No Claim Bonus A No Claim Bonus (NCB) is granted for every claim-free year: 20% after the first year, rising to 25%, 35%, 45%, and a maximum of 50% after five consecutive claim-free years. NCB is forfeited if any claim is made during the policy year. Depreciation and Deductibles For partial loss, depreciation on rubber, plastic, and battery parts is 50%.

text: NCB is forfeited if any claim is made during the policy year. Depreciation and Deductibles For partial loss, depreciation on rubber, plastic, and battery parts is 50%. A compulsory deductible of Rs. 1,000 applies to each claim for vehicles up to 1500cc and Rs. 2,000 above 1500cc. Exclusions Claims are not payable for driving without a valid licence, driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, use of a private car for commercial hire, consequential loss, and normal wear and tear. Claim Intimation Report any accident, theft, or third-party claim to Aegis within 48 hours. For theft, also file a police FIR. Cashless repair is available at over 4,000 network garages; otherwise reimbursement is settled within 7 working days of survey.

doc_title: Aegis Financial - Privacy and Data Protection Policy
text: Aegis Financial - Privacy and Data Protection Policy Aegis Financial · Policy Document · For demonstration only Data We Collect We collect identity, contact, financial, and transactional data necessary to provide services and meet legal obligations. Sensitive personal data is collected only with consent or where permitted by law. Use and Sharing Personal data is used for account servicing, risk assessment, fraud prevention, and regulatory reporting. Data may be shared with credit bureaus, regulators, and service providers under confidentiality obligations. We do not sell personal data. Retention Customer records are retained for a minimum of 5 years after the end of the relationship, or longer where required by law. After the retention period, data is securely deleted or anonymised.

text: ATM and Transaction Limits The daily ATM cash withdrawal limit is Rs. 50,000.
